description: Fetch today's Quant Daily drill (GRE Quantitative Reasoning · GMAT quant). Every conversation receives this same question, already checked to have one correct answer. Returns the exam, the difficulty and the expected time in seconds. Does not return the answer or the worked explanation. English only; lang hi is rejected. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

attemptId.description: Conversation id returned by get_daily_drill on Quant Daily. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Pass this same id on every later call in the conversation.

lang.description: Optional. en only. hi is rejected: Quant Daily is English only.
